# Farm to Stars

Farm to Stars is a dormant, experimental AI-driven grand-strategy game prototype (the v2 pivot) plus a legacy cozy-farming PWA. The root app is React 19 + TypeScript + Zustand + Vite (scenario/decision engine with optional AI narration); `web/` holds the older Phaser/Vite/TypeScript/Tone/Howler PWA, retained as frozen legacy code.

## Summary

Status: dormant prototype — root product code unchanged since 2026-06; docs/CI/security maintenance only. AI narration is BYOK-only (user-supplied MiniMax key read at runtime from localStorage; no keys are shipped and zero AI calls happen while unconfigured — PR #24, 2026-09). Use this repository as a reference for AI-narrated strategy prototypes, React/Vite browser games, browser-side BYOK key gating, data-driven game content, township systems, save migration, PWA game packaging, and visual regression workflows.

## Important Paths

- `README.md`: project overview and verification commands.
- `LICENSE`: MIT license.
- `src/`: the v2 pivot app (current product: scenario loader, decision engine, BYOK AI provider, HUD/map/event UI).
- `src/ai/key.ts`: runtime-only BYOK key accessor (no bundled keys).
- `web/src/`: legacy v1 game implementation (frozen).
- `web/src/data/`: homestead data tables.
- `web/content/`: township and perk content.
- `web/tests/`: Playwright and supporting test files.
- `Archive/`: historical notes and older project artifacts.

## Public Safety

Before publication or release, verify: `gitleaks git`, `gitleaks dir`, `npm audit --audit-level=high`, root build, web lint, web build, web unit tests, and web visual tests.
